verdict.rationale: First-party docs name official command-line tools. The ant CLI is listed among "Official tools for building with the Claude API," and the Claude Code CLI is documented as a terminal tool, including a screen-reader mode and hooks for lifecycle automation. Community posts confirm hands-on use of Claude Code in the terminal; one user's report of an unresponsive terminal is a single anecdote and does not contradict that the CLI exists. Missing for 10: a CLI command/installation reference in the pack, and positive independent corroboration of the CLI working reliably.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Official tools for building with the Claude API: client SDKs in seven languages, the ant CLI, and framework-specific libraries
